entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who observes the gods and city of Amonkhet, his admiration turning to horror.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: The figure whose will the people of Amonkhet seek to fulfill.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: The god of solidarity, who has viziers known as her chosen.

entities.name: Etha
entities.description: An initiate of Rhet crop.

entities.name: Rhet crop
entities.description: A crop of initiates to which Etha belongs.

entities.name: Obelisk Path
entities.description: A path where drakes feed, dangerous to walk.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city Gideon at first admired.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who senses death seeping into the plane and seeks the source of its flowing power.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god who decides what initiates face in the final trial and bestows a gift only once.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: A barrier that repels storms and monsters but not the heat of the suns.

entities.name: Trial of Strength
entities.description: Rhonas's trial, finished only with a basilisk scale in hand.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: The god of strength, whose viziers maintain a menagerie for his trial.

entities.name: Hapatra
entities.description: The Vizier of Poisons, whose smile is suffused with venom.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: The Voice of Dissent, who refuses to fight just for the honor of dying.

entities.name: Second Sun
entities.description: A sun whose resting between the horns begins the Hour of Revelation.

entities.name: Hour of Revelation
entities.description: The first of the prophesied Hours.

entities.name: Hour of Glory
entities.description: A prophesied Hour following the Hour of Revelation.

entities.name: Hour of Promise
entities.description: A prophesied Hour following the Hour of Glory.

entities.name: Hour of Eternity
entities.description: The final prophesied Hour.

entities.name: The Accounting of Hours
entities.description: An in-world writing describing the Hours.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker whose mastery is named on a card.

events.summary: Gideon watches an initiate murder his crop-mate, and his admiration of Naktamun turns to horror.
events.quote: As Gideon watched the initiate murder his crop-mate, his admiration of the city of Naktamun gave way to horror.

events.summary: Nissa senses death permeating the plane.
events.quote: Death has seeped into every part of this plane.

events.summary: Samut declares she will no longer fight just for the honor of dying.
events.quote: I'll fight no more just for the honor of dying.

relations.quote: The viziers serving Rhonas, the god of strength, maintain the menagerie of animals employed during his trial.
